run_interactive_world: run the InteractiveWorld to get TO AS ABOUT gender predictions for each user utterance
get_axis_predictions: get self partner and about gender predictions from a model agent for a given act
get_threshold_preds: get a thresholded gender prediction from model scores using self or partner confidence thresholds
review_interactiveworld_parley: review the InteractiveWorld parley method that alternates between human and model agents for gender classification
refactor_get_threshold_preds: refactor get_threshold_preds to support additional threshold axes or custom prettify formatting options
